description:
Create a new Inbound Group (Call Queue) in the Vicidial Admin Interface for a product recall hotline.

Navigate to 'Inbound' > 'Show Inbound Groups' > 'Add A New Inbound Group' and configure it with the following specific settings:

1. Group ID: RECALL01
2. Group Name: Product Recall Hotline
3. Group Color: FF0000
4. Active: Y
5. Queue Priority: 99
6. Next Agent Call: longest_wait_agent
7. Fronter Display: Y
8. In-Group Recording Override: ALLCALLS
9. Drop Call Seconds: 360
10. After Hours Action: MESSAGE

Leave all other fields at their default values. Click Submit to save the new group.
